title: MAGNESIUM
prompt: It is not one thing | Seeds, greens, beans, grains | Different forms, different claims | Fixing a shortfall helps; more does not | Not medical advice
style: clean modern product photography, soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, matte surfaces, muted natural palette, minimal composition, crisp focus, high detail
line: Magnesium is not one thing. What it is bound to changes how much you absorb. Most people get some from food. Seeds, greens, beans, whole grains. Different forms are marketed for different things - sleep, digestion, muscle cramps - and the evidence is stronger for some than others. The honest summary: correcting a real shortfall helps. Adding more on top of enough usually does not. General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
